20.3 Depression
Depression affects the capabilities of the driver:
Increasing distractions. The driver focuses all his attention on his thoughts and neglects the surroundings.
Making valuable information become lost or irrelevant. The driver fails to detect significant information needed for safety and requiring driver reaction, especially in more complex situations.
Increasing insecurity. Depression interferes in the decision-making process, so the driver can make mistakes or act unpredictably.
Increasing the propensity for sleepiness and fatigue. It is advisable not to drive at night or in environments where road monotony may occur or for long periods of time.
Increasing irritability and anxiety. A trivial event can provoke a disproportionate reaction by the driver.
In addition, there is usually the need for psychotropic drugs, which can directly affect the ability to drive.
(Página 48 del manual 'Learning to drive')

ALCOHOL AND OTHER DRUGS    
 
17.1 Effects of the most common drugs
17.1.3 Ecstasy (MDMA)
It can cause optical illusions (for example, flashes to the periphery of the visual field) leading to the driver driving dangerously and making evasive manoeuvres.
It can cause the user to experience periods of increased sensitivity to light (and therefore a greater tendency to be affected by glare), or episodes of blurred vision.
It reduces the ability to concentrate on the traffic and surroundings, which can lead to an increase risk of distraction.
It can cause episodes of depression or anxiety, both of which maybe very dangerous while driving.
It can cause physical and mental exhaustion after the symptoms disappear.
It can cause flashbacks whilst driving (this revives the effects of the drug several hours after use).
(Página 44 del manual 'Learning to drive')

7 Special circumstances regarding the circulation of traffic and the utilisation of lanes  
 
7.3 Lanes that are set up for use in the opposite direction to the normal one (contra-flows)
7.3.1 For traffic flow reasons
In this case use of the lane, set up for traffic to flow in the opposite direction to normal, is limited to motorcycles and cars, however cars with trailers and all other vehicles are prohibited.
(Página 166 del manual 'Learning to drive')

7 Special circumstances regarding the circulation of traffic and the utilisation of lanes  
   
7.3 Lanes that are set up for use in the opposite direction to the normal one (contra-flows)  
7.3.2 Enabled in a contrary direction due to road works
Where a contra-flow exists due to road works and a lane has been enabled for travel in the opposite direction, then, all types of vehicles are eligible to use the lane(s) – unless expressly prohibited by road signs. The same conditions, as above, are still applicable.
(Página 166 del manual 'Learning to drive')
